mapper.sql: job_code AS jobCode ,job_name AS jobName ,cron_expression AS cronExpression ,zone_id AS zoneId ,business_code AS businessCode ,is_enabled AS enabled ,run_on_startup AS runOnStartup ,catchup_enabled AS catchupEnabled ,lock_timeout_seconds AS lockTimeoutSeconds ,last_started_at AS lastStartedAt ,last_success_at AS lastSuccessAt ,last_status AS lastStatus
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_scheduler_job WHERE is_active = TRUE AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY job_code
SELECT FROM sys_scheduler_job WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} AND is_active = TRUE AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT pause_id AS pauseId ,job_code AS jobCode ,pause_start_at AS pauseStartAt ,pause_end_at AS pauseEndAt ,reason FROM sys_scheduler_pause WHERE is_active = TRUE AND is_deleted = FALSE AND (job_code = #{jobCode} OR job_code IS NULL) AND pause_start_at <= #{now} AND pause_end_at > #{now} ORDER BY pause_end_at DESC

SELECT hold_id AS holdId ,business_code AS businessCode ,hold_start_at AS holdStartAt ,hold_end_at AS holdEndAt ,reason FROM sys_scheduler_business_hold WHERE is_active = TRUE AND is_deleted = FALSE AND business_code = #{businessCode} AND hold_start_at <= #{now} AND hold_end_at > #{now} ORDER BY hold_end_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_scheduler_job SET lock_owner = #{owner} ,locked_at = NOW() ,lock_until = NOW() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}) WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} AND is_active = TRUE AND is_deleted = FALSE AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until < NOW())
